text: Normalization is the process of organizing data to reduce redundancy and improve data integrity in a relational database.
1NF ensures atomic values, 2NF removes partial dependency, and 3NF removes transitive dependency from a table design.
Functional dependency means the value of one attribute determines another attribute in a table, which is crucial for normalization.
CPU scheduling decides which process gets the CPU at a given moment to maximize throughput and minimize waiting time.
